messages:
alex morris: quick heads-up: I'm preparing a tiny tf module refactor for terraform/aws/service-credentials. changing an output name + committing the root lockfile from CI. looking for a quick sanity check

maria gonzalez: which output and why commit the lockfile at root? curious about module-level policy

alex morris: renaming output `service_secret_arn` -> `svc_credentials_arn` to match our short-name convention. CI will produce an updated .terraform.lock.hcl at the repo root after running a providers lock step; I want to commit that so apply in staging is reproducible

jin park: ping re: lockfile policy — do we have consensus to commit root lockfile for infra repo? last guidance I saw said yes for infra stacks, no for registry modules

samir: correct. for this repo (infra repo) we commit root lockfile. for modules published to registry we avoid committing module-level lockfiles. good to keep consistent

maria gonzalez: on provider constraints: please avoid rigid patch pins. prefer ranges like `>= 3.50, < 5.0` unless you hit a regression we need to pin around

alex morris: yep planning to add in module `required_providers` block like:

````
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = ">= 3.50, < 5.0"
    }
  }
}
````

jin park: looks fine. small request: can you paste the exact outputs.tf change? saves me opening the PR for a trivial review

alex morris: sure. outputs.tf before: `output "service_secret_arn" { value = aws_secretsmanager_secret.example.arn }`
after: `output "svc_credentials_arn" { value = aws_secretsmanager_secret.example.arn }`
I'll add a deprecation comment for a release: `# DEPRECATED: service_secret_arn -> use svc_credentials_arn`

samir: also update module README and CHANGELOG with migration note. some services still reference the old output name in compose and bootstrap scripts

maria gonzalez: question about k8s secret name mapping I saw in the PR diff: renaming `svc-credentials` -> `svc-creds`. are we changing the secret namespace or just shorting the name?

alex morris: just shortening name for consistency. plan: add a compatibility shim in k8s manifests for one release so both names are present in staging. remove the old key after we've verified canary and prod smoke

jin park: propose rollout cadence: stage tonight (canary), prod canary Friday 16:00 PST, full prod after metrics stable. gate prod with pipeline smoke and manual ops approval

alex morris: agreed. I'll add manual approval step and a smoke test to the prod job. will also push README + changelog updates on the same PR. will post a heads-up in #general before the prod window

infra-bot: CI started: `infra/terraform-module-scan` (build #782)

infra-bot: CI succeeded: `infra/terraform-module-scan` (build #782) :white_check_mark:

samir: :eyes: on README + k8s shim before merge. also add a short migration snippet for consumers (example terraform block to map old output if needed)

alex morris: good call. I'll include a small example in the README showing a compatibility wrapper: `module.old = { service_secret_arn = module.new.svc_credentials_arn }` and note the removal timeline

maria gonzalez: thanks. one last note: when you commit .terraform.lock.hcl, add a short commit message noting platform+terraform version the lock was generated with (e.g., providers lock --platform=linux_amd64 on terraform v1.6.0)

alex morris: done. I'll include that in the commit message and the PR description. tagging reviewers @maria @jin @samir for final checks :thumbsup:
